control_description: CTES runs in the cloud; physical controls inherited from the cloud provider (SOC 2 Type 2); corporate office badge access
Certified destruction of drives and documents

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS 1.2 or higher for the portal; AS2 signing and encryption for EDI partners

control_description: EDR on cloud virtual machines; managed platform patching

control_description: Monthly vulnerability scans and cloud posture monitoring
gap: 11 of 64 Critical and High findings past due (P07); no configuration drift detection for the portal
remediation: Close overdue findings; drift detection (POAM-014)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: MSSP monitors identity provider, cloud, and firewall logs 24x7
gap: Portal application logs and EDI gateway logs not sent to the SIEM
remediation: Onboard portal and EDI logs to the SIEM

control_description: MSSP triages events and escalates high severity within 30 minutes (22 minutes in the P07 test)

control_description: BIA (P05) covers BP-10 and BP-11; cyber insurance
